lines.zh: 它步履沉重，发出低沉的嗡嗡声。
lines.en: It moves slowly, making a low buzzing sound.

lines.zh: 它张开翅膀，轻盈地飞翔。
lines.en: It spreads its wings and flies lightly.

lines.zh: 它快速掠过，带起一阵微风。
lines.en: It zips by, creating a gentle breeze.

lines.zh: 它在空中盘旋，寻找食物。
lines.en: It circles in the air, searching for food.

lines.zh: 它掠过地面，留下一串闪光。
lines.en: It skims the ground, leaving a trail of sparkle.

lines.zh: 它轻盈地跳跃，避开障碍物。
lines.en: It jumps nimbly, avoiding obstacles.

lines.zh: 它在阳光下闪耀，翅膀发出光芒。
lines.en: It glimmers in the sunlight, its wings radiating light.

lines.zh: 它轻盈地在花丛中穿梭。
lines.en: It weaves through the flower beds nimbly.

lines.zh: 它停在树上，警惕地观察周围。
lines.en: It perches on a tree, watching cautiously.

lines.zh: 它优雅地从一朵花跳到另一朵。
lines.en: It gracefully hops from one flower to another.
I pace the stone rooms of Apalachia.
I shuffle behind my counter.
My hem brushes the glowing moss.
I drift slowly to another spot.

lines.zh: 它静静地站在那里，翅膀轻轻振动。
lines.en: It stands still, wings gently vibrating.
It looks around, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 它静静地等待着，准备捕捉猎物。
lines.en: It waits quietly, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 它享受着微风，翅膀轻摆。
lines.en: It enjoys the breeze, wings swaying gently.

lines.zh: 它轻盈地休息，偶尔扇动翅膀。
lines.en: It rests lightly, occasionally fluttering its wings.

lines.zh: 它安静地栖息，翅膀微微振动。
lines.en: It quietly rests, wings gently vibrating.

lines.zh: 它在阳光下休憩，翅膀闪闪发光。
lines.en: It rests in the sun, its wings shining brightly.

lines.zh: 它静静地观察，等待时机。
lines.en: It quietly observes, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 它静静地享受着这个美好的时刻。
lines.en: It quietly enjoys this moment.

lines.zh: 它静静地等待，翅膀轻轻振动。
lines.en: It waits quietly, wings gently vibrating.
I count today's stock.
I wait for customers in the dim room.

lines.zh: 把手里的东西擦了又擦。
lines.en: I polish what I hold, over and over.
These Apalachia rooms are far too quiet.

lines.zh: 它锐利的目光注视着你，准备攻击。
lines.en: Its sharp gaze fixes on you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它警觉地盯着你，准备随时出击。
lines.en: It watches you alertly, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 它紧盯着你，翅膀微微振动。
lines.en: It stares at you, wings gently vibrating.

lines.zh: 它的眼神里充满了警惕，似乎随时准备战斗。
lines.en: Its gaze is full of alertness, ready for battle.

lines.zh: 它紧张地盯着你，准备扑向你。
lines.en: It fixes on you, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 它警惕地盯着你，随时准备出击。
lines.en: It watches you cautiously, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它凝视着你，翅膀轻轻振动。
lines.en: It stares at you, wings gently vibrating.

lines.zh: 它似乎想要攻击你，但又有些犹豫。
lines.en: It seems to want to attack you, but hesitates.

lines.zh: 它紧紧盯着你，翅膀轻轻振动。
lines.en: It stares at you intently, wings gently vibrating.
A customer? Or a fight?
I only do business here.
Do you have anything to trade?
We can discuss the price.
Hands off the goods. Look at the price first.
I know that look of yours.
Buy or not. Say something.
Ow, my leg!
Ouch, that hurts...
This wound really hurts!
That scrape really hurts!
My wings are hurt...
My hand is hurt...
My foot is hurt...
My wings are cut...
My teeth are hurting me...
My foot wound is healing slowly...

lines.zh: 来尝尝我的苹果吧，美味得很！
lines.en: Try my apples, they're delicious!

lines.zh: 别走！我的面包能让你饱腹！
lines.en: Don't go! My bread will keep you full!

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗？我的蜂蜜蛋糕！
lines.en: You can smell it, right? My honey cake!
My cookies give you strength!

lines.zh: 吃掉这些！它们能让你更健康！
lines.en: Eat these! They'll make you healthier!

lines.zh: 尝尝我的蛋糕吧，甜而不腻！
lines.en: Try my cake, it's sweet but not cloying!

lines.zh: 我的面包里有丰富的营养！
lines.en: My bread is full of nutrients!
Come, enjoy my food!

lines.zh: 我的食物能让你更加聪明！
lines.en: My food makes you smarter!
Eat my cookies, get stronger!

lines.zh: 小心，我的尾巴可以打人！
lines.en: Watch out, my tail can hit you!

lines.zh: 别碰我，我会用木棍打你！
lines.en: Don't touch me, I'll hit you with a stick!
Stay away, I have weapons!
I protect myself with a stick!

lines.zh: 别靠近我，我有防身工具！
lines.en: Don't come near me, I have self-defense tools!
My stick isn't for play!

lines.zh: 我的武器可以吓退敌人！
lines.en: My weapon scares off enemies!
Watch out, my stick will hit back!
Don't mess with me, I have self-defense!

lines.zh: 我的木棍可以击退敌人！
lines.en: My stick repels enemies!
Find a partner to breed!

lines.zh: 我们需要繁殖，为族群增员！
lines.en: We need to breed, for the tribe!

lines.zh: 和我交配吧，我强壮健康！
lines.en: Mate with me, I'm strong and healthy!
Find a partner to continue!
Mate with me to breed!
We need to mate to pass on!
Find a partner to continue the tribe!
Mate to have strong offspring!
Find a partner to strengthen the tribe!
Mate with me, breed offspring!

Uses a wand to heal villagers

Sssss, claws scratch!
Mouth open, fangs bite!
Tail swish, spikes fly!
Poison mist, all around!
Grin wide, crash hard!
Sharp beak, sharp claws!
Stomp foot, poison in!
Swing blade, blood on wall!
Tear flesh, suck essence!
Waving hands, bones crack!
Crack appears, I'm here!
Fog rises, here I come!
Shadows move, I'm here!
In秘界, I wander!
Darkness, I awake!
Secret room, here I am!
Awake from sleep!
In shadows, I move!
Bottom of abyss, here!
Ancient cave, awake!
The fire is burning me!

lines.zh: 我从秘界的石阶滑到下层。
lines.en: I slip from the secret realm's steps to the floor below.
I drowned and it hurts!

lines.zh: 炸开的柜台，把我压在墙角。
lines.en: The counter bursts and pins me in the corner.

lines.zh: 箭钉进货单里，离我手三寸。
lines.en: An arrow pins my invoice, three inches from my hand.
I got hurt by magic!
I'm starving...

lines.zh: 雷从秘界天花板打下来，账本焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes through the secret realm's ceiling; my ledger burns.
I fell into the void and it hurts!
